{{ModeTabs|Story = No}} {{ModeInfobox |title1 = {{Color|CasualMode}} |image1 = GraveDiggerEasyIcon.png |waves = 25 |level_requirement = None |starting_cash = {{Money|500}}
{{Money|600}} (Group Bonus) |time = 10:00 |rewards = {{Coins|450}}, {{Exp|90}} & {{TowerExp|50}} }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|For players who are looking for a casual experience.|Description in Elevators}} }} ==Description== '''Casual''' mode is one of the six main survival modes. The mode has 25 waves, and the final boss is [[Grave Digger]]. Cash is only gained if an enemy is killed, or in some cases, damaged by a specific amount of health. Additionally, the amount gained is a set amount of cash, which is not always equal to the enemy's health. It uses a slightly different method of distributing cash between players, as enemies split their cash between players, regardless of how much damage the player dealt to it. If, in a duo, one player does all the damage to an enemy, both players will receive 50% of the cash the enemy would normally give in solo. This means that in solo, you receive 100% of the cash when an enemy is killed, or it is damaged enough. With each additional player, this is reduced to 50% in duo, 33% in trio and 25% in quad. If it is a decimal, it gets rounded up or down depending on the decimal value. If it is at least 0.5, it gets rounded up. If it is less than 0.5, it gets rounded down. ==Rewards== The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Some maps like [[Mason Arch]] can also increase all rewards by a specific amount. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers. Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal. Rewards are calculated as: {| class="tds-table pad-10" style="text-align: center; margin:1em auto" !Coins Reward !EXP Reward !Tower EXP Reward |- |{{Coins|400}} ÷ (1 + [(25 ÷ Current Wave) - 1]^1.3) + {{Coins|50}} (Triumph Bonus) |{{Exp|75}} ÷ (1 + [(25 ÷ Current Wave) - 1]) + {{Exp|15}} (Triumph Bonus) |{{TowerExp|20}} ÷ (1 + [(25 ÷ Current Wave) - 1]) + {{TowerExp|30}} (Triumph Bonus) |} Triumphing '''Casual''' mode can give out an additional reward, which can be a crate, consumable or ticket. They are meant to be guaranteed, though due to a bug this does not always happen. Additionally, items are sometimes not given out. These items are: *{{Color|Common}} (50%) **[[Grenade]] (1-2) **[[Flash Bang]] (1-2) **[[Molotov]] (1-2) **[[Easter Egg]] (1-2) *{{Color|Uncommon}} (30%) **{{TimeScaleTicket|Time Scale Ticket}} **{{ReviveTicket|Revive Ticket}} *{{Color|Rare}} (20%) **[[Low Grade Crate]] **{{SpinTicket|Spin Ticket}} **[[Barricade]] **[[Supply Drop]] **[[AirStrike]] **[[Ducky Squad]] ===Badges/Achievements=== There are [[badges]] and achievements that you can or could obtain when playing this mode, which may have additional rewards alongside them. These are: {{Badge |title = Defeat Grave Digger |description = Get ready to have your grave dug! |image = D11EasyBadge.png |obtainable = Yes }} {{Badge |title = Average Joe |description = Triumph in Casual mode |image = Achievement |obtainable = Yes |rewards = {{Coins|150}} }} ===Seasons=== During some [[Passes]], the '''Casual''' mode could give currency rewards which you used to progress through a season. 3 Total |} ==Wave Structure== In '''Casual''' mode, the formula for calculating the wave bonus depends on the wave. Between waves 1 and 20, it is: :Waves Completed × {{Money|200}} Between waves 21 and 25, it is calculated as: :{{Money|300}} + (Waves Completed - 1) × {{Money|350}} Depending on player count, the wave bonus is reduced using multipliers. These multipliers are: {| class="wikitable align-center" style="width:50%; margin:1em auto" !Players !Reduction per Player !Total Reduction |- |Solo |0% |0% |- |Duo |5% |10% |- |Trio |5% |15% |- |Quad |5% |20% |} The wave clear bonus appears when every enemy from that wave was killed and no damage was dealt to the base health. It is 35% of the wave bonus in solo, while for duo, trio and quad it is 20%. The waves in '''Casual''' mode follow these timings: {| class="wikitable align-center" style="width:50%; margin:1em auto" !Waves !Wave Timer !Skip TimeHow long you have to wait before you can skip. |- |1-13 |1:00 |0:20Skip at 0:40. |- |14-17 |1:30 |0:30Skip at 1:00. |- |18 |1:30 |0:20Skip at 1:10. |- |19-21 |2:00 |0:20Skip at 1:40. |- |22 |2:00 |0:40Skip at 1:20. |- |23-24 |2:00 |0:20 |- |25 |∞ |N/A |} '''Bolded''' names indicate an enemy type's debut. For former wave structures of '''Casual''' mode, visit the [[Casual Mode/Waves|Waves]] page. The total number of enemies that spawn in '''Casual''' mode, excluding enemies that are summoned, is 601 enemies.
